334: static bool valid_cp_message(const bk7258_mbox_message_t *wire,
335:                              uintptr_t *address)
336: {
337:   *address = wire->data[0];
338:   /* Armino's mbox0_adapter mailbox_buff is an array of 16-byte messages in
339:    * CP .bss and is only word-aligned; 32-byte alignment is reserved for the
340:    * separate exchange payload buffers. */
341:   return wire->src_cpu == 0 && wire->data[1] == sizeof(struct mb_message) &&
342:          (*address & 3u) == 0 && *address >= CP_RAM_START &&
343:          *address <= CP_RAM_END - sizeof(struct mb_message);
344: }

346: static void handle_ack(struct mb_message *message)
347: {
348:   uint8_t logical_channel = message->header >> 24;
349:   uint8_t sequence = message->header >> 16;
350:   bool uart_failed;
351:   unsigned int index;
352: 
353:   if ((message->header & ((uint32_t)CHNL_CTRL_RESET << 12)) != 0)
354:     {
355:       g_stats.reset_count++;
356:       g_phy_busy = false;
357:       (void)dispatch_locked();
358:       return;
359:     }
360: 
361:   if (logical_channel != g_active_channel || sequence != g_active_seq)
362:     {
363:       /* An ACK from a timed-out transmission may arrive after the same
364:        * logical channel has already been retried with a new sequence. It is
365:        * stale and must not release the current in-flight transaction. */
366:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
367:       return;
368:     }
369: 
370:   index = channel_index(g_active_channel);
371:   if (index >= sizeof(g_channel_ids) || !g_channels[index].pending)
372:     {
373:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
374:       g_phy_busy = false;
375:       (void)dispatch_locked();
376:       return;
377:     }
378: 
379:   g_channels[index].pending = false;
380:   if (g_active_channel == MB_CHNL_UART0_TX)
381:     {
382:       uart_failed =
383:         (message->header & ((uint32_t)CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL << 8)) != 0 ||
384:         (message->param1 & 2u) != 0;
385:       if (uart_failed)
386:         {
387:           g_stats.uart_tx_fail++;
388:           g_uart_inflight = 0;
389:           g_uart_retry_after = clock_systime_ticks() + TX_RETRY_INTERVAL;
390:         }

401: 
402:   g_phy_busy = false;
